verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships an official MCP server through its CLI: `pipecat context-hub install` registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent. However, that server only exposes a local index of docs, examples and the API for coding assistance. Nothing shows MCP tools for operating Pipecat Cloud resources such as agents, sessions, secrets or builds. missing for 10: an MCP server that exposes product actions (e.g. managing Cloud agents or deployments), documentation of its tool list, transport and auth setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents)
